environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a private subnet with direct PostgreSQL RDS connectivity. The task role (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/ws-service-task-role) has no permission boundaries attached. RDS instance uses the 'app' user with full SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on all tables in the 'events' database. No network-level SQL inspection. WebSocket endpoint exposed via NLB (Layer 4) with no application-layer filtering.

config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 15, app user has GRANT ALL on schema public
config.db_permissions: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on all tables
